description: This file defines classes and helpers for representing and tracking live entities in Apache Spark, such as jobs, tasks, stages, executors, RDDs, and resource profiles. It includes mutable classes that maintain the evolving state of these entities and methods to generate immutable API views for external consumption.

classes.name: LiveEntity
classes.description: Abstract class representing a mutable, live entity in Spark that tracks evolving state and can produce an immutable API view.

classes.name: LiveJob
classes.description: Represents a live Spark job, tracking task counts, stage IDs, status, and completion info.

classes.name: LiveTask
classes.description: Represents a live Spark task, maintaining task info, metrics, error messages, and updating its state.

classes.name: LiveResourceProfile
classes.description: Tracks a resource profile with executor and task resource requests, providing API conversion.

classes.name: LiveExecutor
classes.description: Represents a live Spark executor, tracking resource usage, status, logs, and producing API summaries.

classes.name: LiveExecutorStageSummary
classes.description: Tracks per-executor stage metrics such as task counts and resource usage.

classes.name: LiveSpeculationStageSummary
classes.description: Tracks metrics for speculative stages, including task counts and failures.

classes.name: LiveStage
classes.description: Represents a live Spark stage, tracking tasks, executor summaries, timing, and producing API data.

classes.name: LiveRDDPartition
classes.description: Represents a partition of an RDD, tracking memory/disk usage and executors.

classes.name: LiveRDDDistribution
classes.description: Tracks data distribution for an RDD on a specific executor.

classes.name: LiveRDD
classes.description: Tracks a persisted RDD, its partitions, distributions, and storage info.

classes.name: SchedulerPool
classes.description: Represents a scheduling pool with associated stage IDs.

classes.name: LiveEntityHelpers
classes.description: Helper object with functions for creating API info, managing accumulators, and metrics calculations.

classes.name: LiveMiscellaneousProcess
classes.description: Tracks a miscellaneous process in Spark, including host, cores, logs, and status.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Saves the current state of the entity to the store, optionally checking triggers.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Generates an immutable API view of the entity's current state.

methods.name: toApi
methods.description: Converts internal data to API data structures for external use.

methods.name: updateMetrics
methods.description: Updates task metrics and computes the delta from previous metrics.

methods.name: createMetrics
methods.description: Creates a TaskMetrics object from raw metric values.

methods.name: makeNegative
methods.description: Converts metric values to negative for non-successful tasks.
